summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear implemented via Leaderboard/Admin UI changes and new mutation handling. REQ-3 is only partially evidenced (frontend display hook present; backend logging/enforcement not clearly shown in the provided backend diff). REQ-4 is partially implemented (new polling+toast hooks), but the Calendar integration appears non-functional (passes null day) and availability toasts do not ensure the new availability is from a different principal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Record each user’s latest sign-in timestamp on login and expose it to admins only (backend-enforced), then display it in Admin UI formatted as readable date/time.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend changes show an Admin page consuming `useGetAllLoginTimestamps` and mapping timestamps, and backend adds `loginRecords`, but the diff excerpt does not show any backend method that (a) updates loginRecords on login/sign-in, (b) provides an admin-only query to fetch timestamps, or (c) enforces admin authorization for that data.
evidence: backend/main.mo (shows `var loginRecords : Map.Map<Principal, Int>`, but no shown update/query/access control for it in excerpt)
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (truncated; mentioned `useGetAllLoginTimestamps` in AdminPage import but not shown implemented in excerpt)

missing_requirements.requirement: Availability notification on Calendar and/or Day Detail: detect new availability added by a different principal and show a toast; avoid re-triggering without changes.
missing_requirements.reason: Calendar view calls `useAvailabilityNotifications(null, true)` but the hook’s query function returns `[]` when `day === null`, so it cannot detect any new availability while viewing the calendar. Also, the hook does not check that the new principal is different from the current caller (it only checks “new principals vs previously seen”), so it may notify for the user’s own availability changes.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useInAppNotifications.ts (no comparison against caller principal; only compares sets of principals)
